name: HighWaterTemp
epl: @Name('HighWaterTemp') select e from Event as e where e.streamId like '%Water_Temperature%' and e.value > 30 and e.confidence > 0.75

name: HighTurbidity
epl: @Name('HighTurbidity') select e from Event as e where e.streamId like '%Turbidity%' and e.value > 15 and e.confidence > 0.75
